shared_elements: human or human-like head at upper part of the composition
horizontal band or ridge crossing the lower area
low-relief linear detailing of hair or surface texture
justification: Both are stone carvings in which a head-like form occupies the upper zone above a lower field containing curved arcs, ring/disc motifs and a horizontal banded division, and both use shallow incised line to articulate detail. But A is a flat, finely worked relief panel with naturalistic profile figures and dense decorative hatching, while B is a coarse three-dimensional monolith with sparse, schematic, weathered motifs, so the correspondence is generic rather than compositional.
